+def _source_input(block: str, field: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, str]]:
+    match = re.search(
+        r"(?m)^[ \t]*"
+        + re.escape(field)
+        + r"\s*=\s*Input\s*\{\s*"
+        r"SourceOp\s*=\s*\"([^\"]+)\"\s*,\s*"
+        r"Source\s*=\s*\"([^\"]+)\"",
+        block,
+    )
+    if match is None:
+        return None
+    return {"source_op": match.group(1), "source": match.group(2)}
+
+
+def _value_input(block: str, field: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    match = re.search(
+        r"(?m)^[ \t]*"
+        + re.escape(field)
+        + r"\s*=\s*Input\s*\{\s*Value\s*=\s*([^,}\n]+)",
+        block,
+    )
+    if match is None:
+        return None
+    return match.group(1).strip()
+
+
+def _fuid_input(block: str, field: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    match = re.search(
+        r"(?m)^[ \t]*"
+        + re.escape(field)
+        + r"\s*=\s*Input\s*\{\s*Value\s*=\s*FuID\s*\{\s*"
+        r"\"([^\"]+)\"",
+        block,
+    )
+    if match is None:
+        return None
+    return 'FuID { "%s" }' % match.group(1)
+
+
+def _comments_input(block: str) -> str:
+    match = re.search(
+        r"(?m)^[ \t]*Comments\s*=\s*Input\s*\{\s*"
+        r"Value\s*=\s*\"((?:\\.|[^\"])*)\"",
+        block,
+    )
+    return match.group(1) if match is not None else ""
+

+def _raw_comp_tools(comp_path: Path) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Parse every generated tool, including tools nested in GroupOperators.
+
+    The shared clipping parser is intentionally conservative about container
+    topology.  P4-05 needs the complete render graph so an internal terminal
+    can be checked against its parent Merge, sibling, or MediaOut consumer.
+    This small fallback parser only reads the generated comp and ignores
+    InstanceInput/InstanceOutput proxy declarations as render consumers.
+    """
+
+    text = comp_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    tools: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for match in _COMP_TOOL_DECLARATION.finditer(text):
+        name, tool_type = match.group(1), match.group(2)
+        if tool_type not in _COMP_TOOL_TYPES:
+            continue
+        opening = text.find("{", match.start(), match.end())
+        end = _balanced_block_end(text, opening)
+        if end < 0:
+            continue
+        block = text[match.start() : end]
+        tool: Dict[str, Any] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "type": tool_type,
+            "start": match.start(),
+            "end": end,
+            "comments": _comments_input(block),
+        }
+        for field, key in (
+            ("Background", "background"),
+            ("Foreground", "foreground"),
+            ("Input", "input"),
+            ("EffectMask", "effect_mask"),
+        ):
+            source = _source_input(block, field)
+            tool[key] = source["source_op"] if source is not None else None
+        for field, key in (
+            ("Operator", "operator"),
+            ("ApplyMode", "apply_mode"),
+        ):
+            tool[key] = _fuid_input(block, field)
+        for field, key in (
+            ("Blend", "blend"),
+            ("ProcessAlpha", "process_alpha"),
+            ("ToAlpha", "to_alpha"),
+            ("ClipBlack", "clip_black"),
+            ("ClipWhite", "clip_white"),
+        ):
+            tool[key] = _value_input(block, field)
+        tools.append(tool)
+    return tools
+
+
+def _all_comp_tools(
+    comp_path: Path, parsed_tools: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]]
+) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Combine the shared parser with a complete nested-tool view."""
+
+    raw_tools = _raw_comp_tools(comp_path)
+    by_name = {tool["name"]: tool for tool in raw_tools}
+    for parsed in parsed_tools:
+        current = by_name.get(parsed["name"])
+        if current is None:
+            raw_tools.append(dict(parsed))
+            by_name[parsed["name"]] = raw_tools[-1]
+            continue
+        for key, value in parsed.items():
+            if value is not None and current.get(key) in (None, ""):
+                current[key] = value
+    return sorted(raw_tools, key=lambda tool: int(tool.get("start", 0)))
+
